mods.name: [NST] Revolvers recoiled
mods.description:
Revolvers recoiled introduces new weapon type into the game - revolvers. Take some gunpowder, collect some materials and have fun with whem.

The mod was developed by a small team. If you find any bugs, please report them on Github Issues - https://github.com/qstargest/NST_Revolvers_recoiled/issues.

releases.notes:
2.0 version for Forge 1.20.1

_Changelog:_

- Improved the arm code and fixed related issues.
- Revolver shooting accuracy has been corrected.
- Improved config, fixed crashes when entering an invalid value, added comments

_New Content:_

- New visuals: models, textures, sounds.
- A new mob-pillager with a revolver – the Bandit! Can spawn naturally at outposts and in patrols, and can be configured in the config.
- The bullet now breaks glass panels when hitting them.
